## Selected Repositories
- `graph-rag-latency-benchmarks`: Python micro-benchmark for Multi-Hop Graph-RAG retrieval (66.9% p95 latency reduction, 3.18x QPS speedup).
- `go-ringbuffer-benchmarks`: Go micro-benchmark comparing Mutex, Buffered Channel, and Lock-Free SPSC Ring Buffer for 50k+ EPS ingestion.
- `jvm-concurrency-benchmarks`: JVM concurrency micro-benchmarks.
